name: scrapingbee-mcp
title: ScrapingBee MCP
summary: Fetch any web page as text, markdown, HTML or a screenshot, extract structured data, and get JSON from Google, Amazon, Walmart and YouTube.
description: Give agents reliable access to live web content. ScrapingBee renders JavaScript and handles CAPTCHAs and anti-bot blocking automatically, so pages that fail with plain HTTP come back as clean text, markdown or HTML. Tools cover page fetch and screenshots, AI-driven extraction of fields described in plain English, file download, and ready-to-use JSON from Google search, Amazon product and pricing, Walmart, YouTube metadata and subtitles, ChatGPT and Gemini. Authentication is a ScrapingBee API key sent as a bearer token; each call spends credits from the user's plan.
